clips.title: The story
paras: In the Wetlands, the Alliance campaign against the Dragonmaw reaches its final strike. With their siege engines sabotaged, the defenders turn on Chieftain Nek'rosh to secure Menethil Harbor. His severed head must be brought to Captain Stoutfist to break the threat to the coastal port.

The Dragonmaw have long plagued the marshlands of Khaz Modan, entrenched in fortified camps and threatening Menethil Harbor's sea lanes. After discovering and burning the clan's catapults, the marsh's defenders strike at the warband's leader. Chieftain Nek'rosh commands the local orcs and remains the last obstacle to breaking the siege. His death leaves the remaining raiders without their leader's direction.

Bring Nek'rosh's severed head to Captain Stoutfist in Menethil Harbor, and Ironforge's garrison will claim a major victory. Without their heavy siege weapons or their chieftain, the Dragonmaw suffer a blow they are unlikely to recover from quickly. Menethil Harbor is the Alliance's main lifeline between Lordaeron and Khaz Modan. With Nek'rosh fallen, the port's docks and trade vessels are safer from sudden attack.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: Now that the catapults have been burned, find and kill Chieftain Nek'rosh.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Stoutly done, friend. You have dealt a telling blow to the Dragonmaw orc clan. They may never recover. And the destruction of those catapults has made Menethil Harbor safe.
You are a traveler of merit, and the kingdom of Ironforge rewards those who serve it well.
